tools.name: list_word_lists
tools.description: Lists word lists as summaries (id, title, language, section, grade range, placement basis code, word count, page URL) without their words; returns { count, note, lists } in dataset order, all matches, no paging. Use this to discover ids, then get_word_list for one list's words; use get_words_for_gra

tools.name: get_word_list
tools.description: Returns one word list in full: the list summary plus every word, its groups (for example -at, -an, -ap families), placementBasisDetail (null for lists in other languages), license and citation text. Use this when you know the list id from list_word_lists; use get_words_for_grade for words merged acr

tools.name: get_words_for_grade
tools.description: Returns every different English word from all lists whose grade range includes a grade, deduplicated, each with the ids of the lists it comes from, plus totalDifferentWords and returned. tools.description: Searches all lists for words matching a letter pattern, for example starts_with 'sh', ends_with 'ck' or contains 'ight'.
